provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

representation: Fit G(t)=G_equilibrium+sum_j A_j*exp(-t/tau_j) by unweighted least squares over every supplied time. Relaxation times are fixed in the stated order and may not be refitted. This candidate generalized-Maxwell model is admitted only if G_equilibrium>=0 and every A_j>=0, to tolerance1e-10MPa.
sampling_policy: Separately report whether every successive supplied G is smaller than its predecessor. Positivity or monotonicity at sampled times alone is not the nonnegative-spectrum criterion. The data are exact controlled values, not noisy observations requiring a significance test.
scope: Qualification within the specified nonnegative discrete Maxwell representation. Rejection is not a proof that every conceivable viscoelastic or nonequilibrium model is impossible.
